subject: DI03000091

body.en:
Understand the idea

Calibration establishes indication/reference relationships and uncertainties under stated conditions;it is not automatically adjustment or a pass certificate.

Explanation and application

  • Use traceable reference standards of suitable uncertainty,stable excitation,correct instrument position and the applicable test plan.Record identification,range,class,temperature,frequency/waveform and warm-up.
  • Compare increasing and decreasing points where required;calculate signed errors/corrections and uncertainty,and apply the authorised decision rule to applicable limits.
  • The syllabus says "as per IS"but gives no standard numbers/editions or acceptance tables.Select the applicable standard for the actual meter type/class;do not invent universal pass limits.
  • IS1248Part2:2021covers analogue ammeters/voltmeters and Part3:2021covers wattmeters/varmeters;energy meters require their own technology/class-specific standard,not automatic use of an analogue pointer-meter class rule.
Calibration equals adjustment?

No;it establishes relationships/errors and uncertainty;adjustment is a separate action.

Understand the idea

Connect test and reference ammeters in the same approved limited-current series circuit;an appropriate standard shunt with reference voltage measurement is an alternative.

Explanation and application

  • Confirm DC/ACtype,frequency,waveform,position,range,polarity and burden;set source to zero before qualified energisation.
  • Take approved points without overload;record reference Irand indication Ii,then e=Ii−Ir,c=−e.Percent error uses the specified reading/span/fiducial base.
  • Increasing/decreasing differences may reveal friction/hysteresis.Class testing also controls influence quantities;one correct full-scale reading does not establish the full class.

Understand the idea

Connect test/reference voltmeters across the same approved stable voltage points;account for their source loading.

Explanation and application

  • Use a limited protected source with suitable range/resolution;check meter type and environmental/reference conditions.
  • Record reference Vrand indication Viat required up/down points;e=Vi−Vr.Corrections are signed values to add to the indication.
  • Illustration only:class1.5specified on a100Vfiducial value permits±1.5Vunder the applicable reference rule;this is not a universal tolerance for every voltmeter or energy meter.

Understand the idea

Compare with a suitable reference power instrument or approved potentiometric/transfer method under controlled voltage,current and pf.

Explanation and application

  • Current and pressure circuits have separate ranges/polarities;follow the approved connection and instrument-loss correction rather than multiplying unrelated readings.
  • For sinusoidal reference power Pr=VrIr cosφr;or use a traceable reference wattmeter/analyser.For non-unity pf,the reference phase relation matters strongly.
  • Error=Wi−Pr;repeat required load/pfpoints and use the authorised fiducial base/uncertainty limits.Do not claim calibration from VIalone at unknown pf.

Given and assumptions

Meter constant K rev/kWh(or impulses/kWh),count N,time t;reference real power Prwatts.

Step-by-step solution

  1. Reference energy Eref=Pr t/3600000kWhwhen tisseconds and power constant;otherwise integrate actual power.
  2. Indicated energy Eind=N/K kWh;error%=(Eind−Eref)/Eref×100.
  3. If timing a fixed count,the theoretical time t0=3600000N/(KPr);error%=(t0/t−1)×100.Fast registration is positive error.
  4. Example:K1200,N20,Pr1000W gives t0=60s.If actual timing is59s,error=+1.69492%;this is a calculated illustration,not a test record.

Interpretation and check

Use the appropriate ISmeter-type/class test plan,reference conditions,pf/load points and uncertainty;do not break seals or adjust revenue meters.

MeterconstantK rev-kWhકેimp-kWh,countN,t/referencePrwattsલો.

  1. t seconds/constantPમાંEref=Pr t/3600000kWhછે.બદલાતાંPમાટેactualintegrationલો.

title.en: Practical.14 Ammeter calibration as applicable IS

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Ammeter calibration as applicable IS

Use the approved rated trainer,instruments/references and manufacturer manual;no physical experiment is claimed.

Connections and instruments

Test/reference meters in an approved limited-current series path or approved standard-shunt method;identify meter type/range/class and standard.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Identify ratings,ranges,terminals,test conditions and stop criteria;prepare an approved diagram and reference/uncertainty plan.
  2. Isolate and verify dead before setup;inspect earthing,protection,guards and leads.Never bypass protection or rewire live.
  3. Test/reference meters in an approved limited-current series path or approved standard-shunt method;identify meter type/range/class and standard.
  4. Use the authorised test points,position,f/waveform and up/down sequence;record genuine indication/reference and uncertainty.
  5. Record only actual readings with units,conditions and uncertainty;leave unperformed observations blank and keep expected calculations separate.
  6. Follow the approved shutdown,discharge and dead-verification procedure before access or reconnection;CT/PTand earth/insulation work require the specific authorised precautions.

Calculations and interpretation

e=Ii−Ir,c=−e;apply the specified fiducial base and authorised uncertainty/decision rule.

Safe fault-finding

One full-scale agreement does not prove the accuracy class;do not invent an ISacceptance table.

Precautions

No CTsecondary open under primary current;no PTsecondary short;no arbitrary insulation voltage or defeated earth.Scope grounds remain PE/common;never lift PEor float an earthed scope.Use approved rated differential/isolated-input methods if needed.

title.en: Practical.16 Wattmeter calibration as applicable IS

body.en:
Aim and apparatus

Wattmeter calibration as applicable IS

Use the approved rated trainer,instruments/references and manufacturer manual;no physical experiment is claimed.

Connections and instruments

Use a traceable power reference and approved current/pressure connections with separate ratings and loss allowance.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Identify ratings,ranges,terminals,test conditions and stop criteria;prepare an approved diagram and reference/uncertainty plan.
  2. Isolate and verify dead before setup;inspect earthing,protection,guards and leads.Never bypass protection or rewire live.
  3. Use a traceable power reference and approved current/pressure connections with separate ratings and loss allowance.
  4. Set approved V,I,pfconditions and compare readings over the authorised test plan;no live polarity reversal.
  5. Record only actual readings with units,conditions and uncertainty;leave unperformed observations blank and keep expected calculations separate.
  6. Follow the approved shutdown,discharge and dead-verification procedure before access or reconnection;CT/PTand earth/insulation work require the specific authorised precautions.

Calculations and interpretation

Pr=VrIr cosφrfor valid sinusoidal reference or direct reference W;e=Wi−Pr.

Safe fault-finding

VIis not real power at unknown pf;phase errors can dominate low-pftests.

Precautions

No CTsecondary open under primary current;no PTsecondary short;no arbitrary insulation voltage or defeated earth.Scope grounds remain PE/common;never lift PEor float an earthed scope.Use approved rated differential/isolated-input methods if needed.

Aim and apparatus

Single-phase energy-meter calibration

Use the approved rated trainer,instruments/references and manufacturer manual;no physical experiment is claimed.

Connections and instruments

Use an approved protected load/reference-power/energy arrangement with actual meter constant and type/class test standard.

Qualified-supervised procedure

  1. Identify ratings,ranges,terminals,test conditions and stop criteria;prepare an approved diagram and reference/uncertainty plan.
  2. Isolate and verify dead before setup;inspect earthing,protection,guards and leads.Never bypass protection or rewire live.
  3. Use an approved protected load/reference-power/energy arrangement with actual meter constant and type/class test standard.
  4. Count genuine disc revolutions/pulses and time at authorised load/pfconditions;maintain all rated circuits and do not break seals.
  5. Record only actual readings with units,conditions and uncertainty;leave unperformed observations blank and keep expected calculations separate.
  6. Follow the approved shutdown,discharge and dead-verification procedure before access or reconnection;CT/PTand earth/insulation work require the specific authorised precautions.

Calculations and interpretation

Eind=N/K,Eref=Pr t/3600000kWh;error=(Eind−Eref)/Eref×100.Check count/timing uncertainty.

Safe fault-finding

Creeping,starting behaviour or pulse-mode errors require the appropriate standard procedure,not seal/magnet adjustment.

Precautions

No CTsecondary open under primary current;no PTsecondary short;no arbitrary insulation voltage or defeated earth.Scope grounds remain PE/common;never lift PEor float an earthed scope.Use approved rated differential/isolated-input methods if needed.
